title: AI-Workflow Terminal Failure Record
description: Canonical record for exhausted loops, unrecoverable errors, and aborted escalations. A pipeline result carrying an unresolved terminal record for a promotion-affecting phase must fail its release gate — degradation is never silent.

reason_chain.description: Ordered causes, root first: what failed, what was tried, why it terminated.

resolved.description: True only when a human decision (recorded decision_id) explicitly dispositions the failure. Unresolved terminals block release gates.

resolution_decision_id.description: Registry decision id that resolved the terminal record, if any.
